Allow calling bpf_map_update_elem on sockmap and sockhash from a BPF
context. The synchronization required for this is a bit fiddly: we
need to prevent the socket from changing its state while we add it
to the sockmap
column2: since we rely on getting a callback via

column1: sk_prot->unhash. However
column2: we can't just lock_sock like in

column1: sock_map_sk_acquire because that might sleep. So instead we disable
softirq processing and use bh_lock_sock to prevent further
modification.
Yet
column2: this is still not enough. BPF can be called in contexts where

column1: the current CPU might have locked a socket. If the BPF can get
a hold of such a socket
column2: inserting it into a sockmap would lead to

column1: a deadlock. One straight forward example are sock_ops programs that
have ctx->sk
column2: but the same problem exists for kprobes

column1: We deal with this by allowing sockmap updates only from known safe
contexts. Improper usage is rejected by the verifier.
I've audited the enabled contexts to make sure they can't run in
a locked context. It's possible that CGROUP_SKB and others are
safe as well
column2: but the auditing here is much more difficult. In

column1: any case
column2: we can extend the safe contexts when the need arises.
